edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by _msgSender, making the caller identity flow into all authorization logic.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender(), so the untrusted caller address participates in the access-control predicate.
owner() is read inside the onlyOwner require to authorize privileged calls.
EnableRedistroibutions is guarded by onlyOwner and mutates the transfer whitelist.
Renounce is guarded by onlyOwner and rewrites the restricted destination address.
Ownable constructor writes the deployer address into _owner.
Local msgSender (from _msgSender) is stored into _owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
ERC20 constructor assigns the name argument to _name.
ERC20 constructor assigns the symbol argument to _symbol.
name() returns _name.
symbol() returns _symbol.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
account parameter indexes _balances in balanceOf.
transfer delegates the movement of funds to _transfer with _msgSender().
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
spender parameter flows into the allowance write of approve.
amount parameter flows into the allowance write of approve.
recipient parameter flows into transfer/_transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer/_transfer balance arithmetic.
transferFrom performs the token movement through _transfer.
sender parameter selects the debited balance in transferFrom.
recipient parameter selects the credited balance in transferFrom.
amount parameter drives both the allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()] is loaded into local currentAllowance.
currentAllowance is decremented by amount before being written back.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance performs the allowance addition.
Existing allowance is read from _allowances for the addition.
The computed allowance sum is persisted through _approve.
decreaseAllowance performs the allowance subtraction.
currentAllowance is compared against subtractedValue in the require.
currentAllowance participates in the subtraction.
The reduced allowance is written back via _approve.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
Cached senderBalance is used for the subtraction.
senderBalance feeds the senderBalance - amount reduction.
_balances values are rewritten by the balance arithmetic.
_mint runs the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting.
_burn runs the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
Base hook dispatch is overridden by Naruto._beforeTokenTransfer, an indirect callback into contract-specific logic.
Overridden hook relates to the base empty hook it replaces.
_uni is the comparison target for the to parameter and thus determines whether enforcement applies.
_enable[from] is read by the require inside the overridden hook.
The from parameter indexes the _enable whitelist inside the hook.
The to parameter is compared with _uni in the hook condition.
The amount parameter is forwarded through the hook signature.
from determines the whitelist lookup in require(_enable[from]).
_enable mapping is consulted by the reverting require.
The overridden _mint evaluates the hard-cap arithmetic before minting.
amount parameter drives the overridden mint logic.
account parameter is forwarded to super._mint by the override.
ERC20.totalSupply() is one operand of the cap comparison.
amount is the other operand of the cap comparison.
The override forwards execution to the base ERC20._mint via super.
Naruto constructor calls _mint, dispatching to the overridden capped version.
Constructor whitelists the initial holder by writing _enable[hardcoded] = true.
EnableRedistroibutions writes the _enable whitelist mapping.
user parameter is the key written into the whitelist.
enable parameter is the value written into the whitelist.
Renounce assigns the restricted destination into _uni.
uni_ parameter is stored into the privileged _uni state variable.
Naruto constructor invokes the inherited ERC20 constructor with name and symbol.

normalization_plan.reason: The user parameter only exists to key the whitelist write performed by EnableRedistroibutions.
The enable parameter only exists to supply the value written by EnableRedistroibutions.
uni_ is used solely as the right-hand side of the _uni assignment in Renounce.
The local msgSender is a transient alias immediately stored into _owner by the constructor.
Current allowance cache scoped to the transferFrom allowance reduction.
Current allowance cache scoped to the decreaseAllowance subtraction.
Spender parameter is consumed only by the approve allowance write.
Amount parameter is consumed only by the approve allowance write.
Recipient parameter exists only to route the transfer destination.
Amount parameter exists only to size the transfer.
Sender parameter is consumed only by the transferFrom debit path.
Recipient parameter is consumed only by the transferFrom credit path.
Amount parameter drives both allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
from is only used to index the _enable whitelist inside the hook.
to is only compared against _uni inside the hook.
amount is unused by the hook body and exists only to match the override signature.
account is forwarded untouched to super._mint by the capped override.
amount is the operand of the cap arithmetic enforced by the override.
senderBalance is a transient cache used for the sender debit arithmetic in _transfer.
account parameter is only used as the _balances lookup key in balanceOf.
